jobs.title: Check the hot water relief valve
jobs.description: Lift the lever for 10 seconds, check it stops running.
directions: Find the valve and where its drain line ends
Keep everyone clear of the drain line
Lift the lever gently for 10 seconds
Lower it and check the flow stops

jobs.title: Change the under-sink water filter
jobs.description: Carbon cartridge. Family of four, so every 12 months.
directions: Turn off the isolation valve and open the tap
Towel and bucket under the filter
Twist out the old cartridge, fit the new one
Turn on slowly, check for leaks and flush
Write the date on the cartridge
